Definition
[Rough Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0297 ↗ appa-def-covariant-derivative-general-tensor 1. Section A.4\group second-order-differential-operators

The rough Laplacian is the family of operators \[ \Delta : C^\infty (T_p^q \mathcal M^n)\to C^\infty (T_p^q \mathcal M^n) \] defined by \[ (\Delta A)(Y_1,\ldots ,Y_p;\theta _1,\ldots ,\theta _q) = \sum _{i=1}^n (\nabla ^2 A)(e_i,e_i,Y_1,\ldots ,Y_p;\theta _1,\ldots ,\theta _q). \]
